iRule(1)						BIG-IP TMSH Manual						  iRule(1)

PEM_POLICY
       This event is triggered when a PEM policy is evaluated.

DESCRIPTION
       This event is triggered when a PEM policy is evaluated.

       Note: the Policy Enforcement Manager license is required for functionality to work.

Examples
	when PEM_POLICY {
	  PEM::session create 117.13.4.135 subscriber-id test-id subscriber-type e164
	}

HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-11.4.1 --First introduced the event.

BIG-IP							    2022-04-12							  iRule(1)
